spanish: Y toda abertura de asno redimirás con cordero, y si no redimes, y le romperás la cerviz; y todo primogénito de hombre en tus hijos redimirás.

findings.issue: H6363 is the concrete firstling (that which opens the womb), construct with the donkey; «abertura» substitutes an aperture and omits the firstling.
H7716 is one of the flock (sheep or goat), common gender, age unspecified; «cordero» narrows it to a young male sheep.
Qal imperfect 2ms under אִם is smoothed to present «redimes»; same addressee and same verb.

notes: Person, number, the 3ms suffix, and both conjunctions otherwise match the tokens.
